notes: Self-declared 3D Tower Defense, so Strategy leads, and the bosses, targeting, upgrades and difficulty voting are systems on top of one defended route rather than a second layout genre. Shape is lane-actor-track: every map is specified as a clearly defined path from an enemy entry point to a goal with valid and invalid tower ground either side, and the answer gives each of the five maps its own distinct route — that continuity requirement is the P6 and it is not overridable. P4 follows from the five separate maps plus the lobby the elevators teleport out of, which cannot share one surface. Decided without a user: cover-los carries the per-map obstacles and environmental elements the prompt asks for, the tower preview and range circles are UI rather than layout so they are dropped from the handoff, and the compact see-it-at-a-glance lane from the answer sets the scale for all five maps.
